capabilities: Measure word, sentence, paragraph, and syllable counts
Compute readability scores such as Flesch, Gunning Fog, SMOG, and Lix
Estimate grade-level difficulty and an overall readability rating
Report reading and speaking time estimates
Analyze a selected text section instead of the whole document
extras: Syllable-based indicators are calibrated for English and may miscount other languages; the README includes no screenshots or troubleshooting.
intentEvidence: Provides real-time text analysis and feedback, focusing on readability, structure, and style
problem: Obsidian's core word count only tallies words, giving writers no deeper feedback on readability, sentence complexity, or vocabulary difficulty.
summary: Text analysis plugin that runs over 30 readability, structure, and complexity indicators on notes or text selections in real time.
